businesses.business: independent petroleum refining and fuel logistics

offering_description.value: Operates independent crude oil refineries that produce gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and asphalt, sold to wholesale and commercial customers. Also owns midstream logistics assets (pipelines, terminals, storage) for crude and refined products, and sells fuel through wholesale channels.

primary_products.value: gasoline; diesel; jet fuel; asphalt; other refined petroleum products

primary_services.value: crude oil and refined product pipeline transportation; terminalling and storage; crude gathering; wholesale marketing and logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesale fuel distributors, retailers, commercial and industrial fuel buyers, traders, and midstream shippers; B2G: military and government fuel and asphalt buyers, including road agencies

end_markets.value: transportation fuels; energy; road construction; aviation

revenue_model.value: product sales: refined fuels and asphalt sold at market-linked prices; service fees: pipeline tariffs, terminalling and storage fees from midstream operations

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: refines purchased crude oil into fuels and asphalt, sold to wholesale and commercial buyers; asset operator: operates pipelines, terminals and storage moving crude and refined products for shippers

geography_served.value: US regional: Refineries in Texas, Arkansas and Louisiana, markets in the south-central US and Gulf Coast, midstream in Permian Basin and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: refining, midstream logistics, and wholesale fuel marketing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale and rack sales of fuels to distributors, commercial and military customers; other: pipelines and terminals delivering product to rack and export markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Refining and pipelines face EPA emissions and fuel standards, renewable fuel rules, OSHA process safety, PHMSA pipeline regulation

notes: Portfolio reflects the refining and logistics focus after retail divestiture; exact current asset mix (e.g., Delek Logistics ownership, any refinery changes) may have shifted.
